Neurologically Bridget and Jared recently opened Healthy Families Chiropractic in Wellington after many years of practice in Canada. They specialise in working with neurodiverse children and those facing chronic health challenges, using a neurologically-focused approach to help restore balance and calm to the body. Their work centres on regulating the autonomic nervous system — helping children shift out of constant fight-or-flight and into the parasympathetic state, where healing, growth, and development take place. This process involves activating key areas such as the prefrontal cortex and vagus nerve, which play crucial roles in emotional regulation, focus, digestion, sleep, anxiousness, immune function, and overall resilience.  In their practice, they use three core neurological assessments that measure:  Dysautonomia, an imbalance in how the body’s stress and relaxation systems function,  Dysponesis, wasted or inefficient nerve energy that creates tension and poor coordination, and  Overall nervous system regulation to track adaptability and progress.  These tests allow them to see real, measurable changes as a child’s brain and body begin to work together the way they’re designed to.
